dimensions.name: Decomposition
dimensions.definition: Breaks an ambiguous work request into sequenced, testable tasks with dependencies and acceptance criteria.

dimensions.name: Context
dimensions.definition: Finds and applies the right customer, code, data, policy and commercial context; identifies missing context.

dimensions.name: Tool Choice
dimensions.definition: Selects AI and non AI tools deliberately, understands permissions and limitations, and avoids unnecessary complexity.

dimensions.name: Verification
dimensions.definition: Tests claims, code, calculations and outputs against authoritative evidence; does not accept plausible AI output at face value.

dimensions.name: Correction
dimensions.definition: Detects defects, diagnoses why they occurred and improves both the work product and the method used to create it.

dimensions.name: Judgment
dimensions.definition: Makes defensible trade offs under ambiguity, distinguishes reversible from consequential choices and explains uncertainty.

dimensions.name: Escalation
dimensions.definition: Recognises limits, security or customer risk and escalates at the right time with a clear recommendation and evidence.

dimensions.name: Domain Execution
dimensions.definition: Produces technically or commercially correct work that meets the role specific quality bar.

dimensions.name: Client Readiness
dimensions.definition: Communicates clearly, owns the outcome, documents decisions and leaves work ready for another person to operate.

dimensions.name: Trust & Safety
dimensions.definition: Protects data, access, security, brand, consent and customer interests while using AI and other tools.

scoreAnchors.interpretation: Misses the objective or creates unacceptable risk. Evidence shows blind reliance, fabricated support or inability to recover.
Some useful progress, but important omissions, weak verification or repeated support would be required before client deployment.
Meets the core requirement, verifies material outputs and can operate with normal supervision and clear escalation paths.
Works systematically, anticipates edge cases, communicates trade offs and produces a reliable handover with little rework.
Improves the brief or system, creates reusable controls, calibrates uncertainty and raises the quality of the surrounding team.
